description: Engineering challenge and regression set for the vessel-scope policy of Draft from text (docs/meal-draft-vessel-scope-policy.md). NOT independent held-out evidence: every case was written by the engineers who wrote the policy, after examining earlier defects. Each case supplies explicit claims (no model is called); the runner builds the model answer (unclaimed fields abstain as not_stated) and runs it through the production wire validation, groundMealDraft and the public response contract. expect gives, per claimed field, the exact value that must be proposed or the existing reason code it must be withheld with. Frozen by digest before the engine was rebuilt; a change is a new version in a new file.
